scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Guest Book starts the authenticated shared six-minute Proof Forge clock
Remote method selection requires proximity to its physical altar
Late join restores the actual selected method and exact deadline
Wrong method charges the authenticated sender despite a forged actor field
Replayed method submission cannot add another mistake
Guest snapshot cannot forge Proof Forge completion
Identification timeout retains selected method and charges the Book activator once
Timed-out T5 still reserves the unfinished team topic
Teammate retries the same method answer at the Book
Teammate corrects the same method and shares its original explanation
T5 remains reserved between challenges
Assigned proof starts five tablets without a redundant method selection
Guest cannot steal a teammate's carried tablet
Master handoff keeps solved identification, carried tablet and deadline
Departure returns held tablets while preserving reservation and mistake identity
Timeout retains the unfinished proof and charges the current Book activator once
Guest Book retry keeps current tablet arrangement
Only the captured player loses topic interaction authority
Captured guest cannot pick a valid nearby tablet
Photon stage 2 shares accepted method, proof and explanation
Gate timeout cannot clone solved tablet IDs into the next networked challenge
Network Book-gate timeout starts the next proof with empty sockets
Photon stage 3 shares accepted method, proof and explanation
Photon stage 4 shares accepted method, proof and explanation
Photon stage 5 shares accepted method, proof and explanation
Five shared Proof Forge stages freeze time and release the next topic
T5 network play preserves every other topic's state and clock
